explication: ascii.live serves looping ASCII animations over HTTP to curl clients. The main workflow routes a request to an animation, checks that it exists and that the client identifies as curl, then streams frames until the client disconnects; `/list` exposes available names. The README documents a catalog of contributed animations. The animation registry and playback type are represented together because the source excerpt does not show their implementation; the README supports the registration relationships, but individual registrations were not inspected.
